changes: Theater mode: press F9 (or Settings → Theater, the right stick press, or the Theater button on a touch screen) to fly a free camera while your character stays put; the HUD hides.
Camera moves from presets (orbit, dolly, track, rise, pan) around you, a creature or a point, with sliders, and keyframed paths on a timeline you can play, save, export and import.
Record the view to a video file in 9:16 or 16:9 at 720p to 1920p and 24, 30 or 60 fps, without the HUD.
